messages:
anita: kicking off canary for model=v2f-int4-lite on slice=prod-3pct, traffic_seed=42 — will run for ~30m, shadow baseline nf4
canary-bot: canary started (id=canary-3612345678). target=3% prod slice, sample_size=1.2k, evals queued: long_context, instr-follow, safety-smoke
ryan: quick note — seeing tail latency creep already: p90 +12ms, p99 +45ms on batch sizes 1->4, not sure if kv cache misses are worse for int4
cheng: do we have early-quality diffs? any MRR/ROUGE drop on core slices? also curious about hallucination rate on long-context tests
canary-bot: interim A/B summary (B=v2f-int4-lite vs A=nf4):
```
metric, A_mean, B_mean, delta
MRR@20, 0.732, 0.725, -0.007
long_halluc_rate, 0.012, 0.020, +0.008
avg_latency_ms, 72, 84, +12
```
sofia: that's a non-trivial bump in long_halluc_rate (+0.8pp absolute). our preflight threshold for hallucinations is 0.5pp absolute, and MRR drop >0.5pp should auto-trigger fallback — we breached on hallucinations
anita: thanks. proposing a "stability_fence" rule to auto-fallback. draft config below — feedback?
```
{ "gate_name": "stability_fence_v1",
  "slice_rules": [
    {"slice":"core","mrr_delta_threshold": -0.005,"halluc_pp_abs_threshold": 0.005},
    {"slice":"long_context","mrr_delta_threshold": -0.003,"halluc_pp_abs_threshold": 0.005}
  ],
  "lookback": "30m",
  "min_samples": 500,
  "action_on_breach": "immediate-fallback-to: nf4"
}
```
ryan: +1 to adding slice-specific thresholds. also we should make the min_samples per-slice so rare slices don't block an auto-fallback. edge cases otherwise
cheng: curious if the long_context eval harness is sampling any user-specific prefixes that bias toward token patterns int4 struggles with — want to run the harness with stratified sampling by prefix-length and token-entropy
sofia: agree with stratified checks. for now i'd recommend halting the ramp and performing targeted rollbacks if the gate trips
anita: halting ramp now and invoking fallback. running focused stratified evals (long_context x token_entropy bins). initiating rollback command: `redwoodctl rollout abort --canary canary-3612345678 --fallback nf4`
canary-bot: rollback executed for canary-3612345678. traffic reverted to nf4. postmortem ping will be created in #postmortems once the evals finish :white_check_mark:
cheng: follow-up action: add per-slice min_samples and entropy stratification to preflight, and add a small synthetic stress bench for int4 attention kernels
anita: noted. I'll open a PR with config changes and a small runbook for stability_fence gating. tagging @sofia for final sign-off on thresholds :thumbsup:
sofia: ack, will review thresholds this afternoon. thanks all.
